objectives.title: Get a first statement on record
objectives.detail: Someone on these streets will talk to a detective nobody has heard of yet. Knock until a door opens, and take the statement that is offered.

objectives.title: Earn the credibility for the doors that stayed shut
objectives.detail: Most of the people on the list will not talk to a stranger. Every statement that helps a neighbor raises your credibility, and every interview that goes wrong lowers it. Their gates are on the People page.

objectives.title: Find who made the calls
objectives.detail: A voice, a script and a number. Somebody at the shops on Sampaguita Street works the floor those calls come from, and asking him costs no statement.

objectives.title: Get the name of the director
objectives.detail: He will not give up his director for nothing. What moves him is a witness he called: a statement from someone on his floor's list, presented to his face.
objectives.failed_detail: He stopped talking and asked for a lawyer. Nobody else on the floor will name the director - unless a witness he called can still be found and brought back to him.

objectives.title: File the case with what it has
objectives.detail: Nobody who made the calls is talking, or there are no statements left to take. If nothing you are holding will move the operator, the office door on Sampaguita Street will take the file as it stands.

objectives.title: Name who owns the call floors
objectives.detail: The floor directors answer to a name on the leases, and Elena's floor only comes down with its owner if that name is in the file - without it, the owner walks. Two people know it: the closer in the tower lobby on Terminal Road, who will trade it for two statements with names on them, and the director of the fourth floor, up the stairwell from the call floor, whose door opens once one of her recruits has turned. Get it before you open Elena's door.

objectives.title: Confront the floor director
objectives.detail: The operator named her. Her door is at the far end of the call floor, past the desks - walk the floor before you open it. Two statements from people her floor called are enough to hold her; the owner's name in the file is what brings the company down with her. Her door is the end of the case.

objectives.title: Turn someone who works on the fourth floor
objectives.detail: The floor above the call floor hires by the batch. One of its recruits boards on Terminal Road, at a gate of 65 - and what will move her is not a badge but someone who answered the same advertisement she did.

any.milestone: Her Name Is On The Rack
